# Support triage

## What this is

An agent that reads a support ticket, finds what the handbook says about it, and writes the
reply the person on the rota would have written.

## Who it is for

The person on the support rota, who answers the same handbook questions every morning.

## What it works on

A ticket as the customer wrote it, and the support handbook.

## Where this is going and where it is not

It drafts. A person presses send. It never sends on its own and never edits the handbook.

## What is still open

Whether it should answer anything the handbook does not cover.
